threads.body: [General] `GraphqlSingletons` is not fully canonical for the ordering above: its constructor reads `add_operation_name_to_span_name` before `operation_name_in_span_name` and warns even when the replacement is set (lines 72–90). Scope this reference to the helper that actually follows steps 1 and 3 so agents do not copy the conflicting path.

replies.body:
Addressed in e162e0e22db5570e8c2ed41cc497be7526331b8e.

Analysis: The canonical list referred to the entire `GraphqlSingletons` class even though only `Configuration.getQuerySanitizationEnabled` reads the replacement first and warns only when applying the deprecated value. Narrowing the reference identifies the compliant implementation without endorsing the constructor's conflicting path.

Upsides: Agents are directed to an implementation that follows the documented v3-preview deprecation sequence and will not copy the constructor's eager deprecated-property handling.

Downsides: The reference is slightly more verbose; no material behavioral downside identified.
